package.name: robot_sim
package.description: Kinematic simulator for the mobile manipulator. Emulates ONLY the hardware-owner boundary (base drive + odom, front/hand camera tag detections, arm move_cart protocol, lifter) so the REAL navigation and calibration nodes (mobile_node, path_tag_locator) run unmodified against it. No physics engine — unicycle kinematics + a pinhole camera over map.yaml / reference_tags ground truth.
